k-gta6.title: GTA6 cat Mabel coins
k-gta6.sourceSays: Posts say a Rockstar VP of UI design revealed the cat in GTA6 is named Mabel after his own cat; coins named for the cat followed. The quoted claim is not independently verified here.
k-gta6.reason: Posts from Nov 18 19:45-20:03 UTC relay the VP's remark about Mabel the cat; the GTA6 CAT pool opened about an hour ago, after the news. Snapmatic is older and not part of this story.
